findings.issue: Required input/select/textarea boundaries contrasted 1.49:1 in light mode and 2.10:1 in dark mode against their surfaces.
findings.fix: Separate control-border token: #778078 on #fff (4.08:1) and #8ca493 on #233129 (5.09:1). Decorative dividers keep their lighter token.
findings.evidence: Rendered light-mode CSS inspected; dark provider palette checked; full light/dark scans and control checks after change.

findings.confidence: confirmed scanner flag; no human speech-input test
findings.issue: axe flagged the brand on every page: decorative text glyph and an overriding aria-label created ambiguous visible/name matching.
findings.fix: Use an empty-alt logo image and derive the link name from visible brand text plus a hidden home suffix.
findings.evidence: 31 baseline label-content-name-mismatch results; zero after change in all four page profiles. Native accessibility name is a11y oop home.

findings.issue: Adapted explanatory asides created repeated unnamed complementary landmarks; desktop/mobile screen-reader navigation groups also lacked distinct names.
findings.fix: Use non-landmark note wrappers and distinct navigation labels without changing prose.
findings.evidence: Baseline landmark-unique results on four pages; none in final scans.

findings.issue: A Note label in the development introduction skipped from the page h1 to h3.
findings.fix: Keep the word Note as emphasized text instead of a structural heading.
findings.evidence: Baseline heading-order result; none after change. Not independently asserted as a WCAG failure.

findings.confidence: source risk before change; corrected runtime behavior observed
findings.issue: Focus ownership was checked after hiding a filtered-out card, when the browser could already have moved focus away.
findings.fix: Capture focus ownership before filtering, then focus a results heading that becomes visible on focus.
findings.evidence: Changing TAB01 to Pass under the Not assessed filter reduced four visible checks to three and placed focus on Checklist results. Subsequent Tab navigation reached Export, Import and Start over.

findings.issue: Home statistics used aria-label on an unnamed generic div, flagged as incomplete by axe.
findings.fix: Give the intentionally named statistics collection a group role.
findings.evidence: No aria-prohibited-attr result on home in final scans.

findings.issue: The recipe page code block lacked the prose wrapper that constrains overflow; the whole page scrolled horizontally at 320 CSS pixels.
findings.fix: Apply the existing prose/code styling so the code example can scroll within its own region.
findings.evidence: Baseline 320-pixel page overflow; no page-wide overflow in all 124 final page scans.

findings.issue: Overflowing code examples on CI/CD, Content and Development could not receive keyboard focus at narrow widths.
findings.fix: Give code examples tabindex=0 only when they actually overflow; ResizeObserver updates this as layout changes.
findings.evidence: Three baseline scrollable-region-focusable results; none in final 320-pixel profiles.

manualChecks.actual: Four checks became three; focus moved to visible Checklist results heading. Selection used the native control value API, not a full select-menu keyboard test.

manualChecks.method: Native browser keyboard and accessibility-tree observation

manualChecks.actual: Three Tabs from results heading and Enter opened reset. Keep my progress received focus; Tab reached Clear all progress; Escape returned to Start over. Background content was absent from modal AX scope.

manualChecks.expected: Focused toolbar action has a visible indicator.
manualChecks.actual: Start over matched :focus-visible; solid 3px rgb(153,80,0) outline. Dialog screenshot recorded cancel focus and unobscured content.

manualChecks.expected: Confirmation clears results, keeps filters and returns focus.
manualChecks.actual: After confirm: 0 of 66 reviewed, four table checks restored, filters unchanged, focus on Start over.

manualChecks.method: Native browser interaction and accessibility tree
manualChecks.expected: Unexplained N/A does not count; expose its reason control; count only once a reason is supplied.
manualChecks.actual: Details opened automatically; required reason and instruction exposed; count stayed zero until text was entered, then became one. Test result was cleared afterward.

coverageGaps.details: No real screen-reader speech, speech-input, magnifier, switch-control or participant session. AX snapshots are not substitutes. Dynamic announcement quality still needs human verification.

No actual browser zoom/text-only 200% session, WCAG text-spacing override, portrait/landscape device session or complete target-size exception inventory in this run. Narrow 320-pixel reflow scans do not replace these.

Dialog state scans open dialogs directly and are not end-to-end file-upload tests.

Reset paragraph was visibly legible and measured #242c28 on #fff in light mode; dark CSS uses #eff3eb on #233129. Offscreen cells remain review items, not failures or automated passes.
